name: FindA.Sale
description: Find yard sales, garage sales, auctions, flea markets and resale shops, and search items for sale.

tools.name: search_sales
tools.title: Search Sales
tools.description: Find current public sales (yard and garage sales, whole-house sales, auctions, flea markets, shops) by keyword, city, ZIP, map point, date range or sale type. Returns sale summaries with approximate location and a link to each sale page. Street addresses are never included.

tools.name: get_sale
tools.title: Get Sale Details
tools.description: Get one public sale: dates, city, approximate location, description, photos, organizer name and rating, and up to 25 available items. Street addresses are never included; the sale page shows them to signed-in shoppers from the day before the sale.

tools.name: search_items
tools.title: Search Items
tools.description: Search items listed for sale across current public FindA.Sale sales by keyword, with optional category, condition, price range and city filters. Returns item title, price, condition, photos and links to the item and its sale.

tools.name: get_item
tools.title: Get Item Details
tools.description: Get one publicly listed item: title, description, price, condition, photos, and the sale it belongs to (title, city, dates, link).

tools.name: list_cities
tools.title: List Cities
tools.description: List cities with current public sales on FindA.Sale, busiest first, with active sale counts and a browse link for each city. Filter by state to narrow the list.

tools.name: list_sale_types
tools.title: List Sale Types
tools.description: List the sale type codes FindA.Sale uses (yard sale, whole-house sale, auction, flea market, shop, dorm move-out) with a short description of each.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List Categories
tools.description: List item categories that currently have items for sale, with item counts. Use a name from this list as the category filter in search_items.

tools.name: get_trending_sales
tools.title: Get Trending Sales
tools.description: List current public sales with the most shopper interest and recent activity, optionally in one city or of one sale type.

tools.name: get_sales_starting_soon
tools.title: Get Sales Starting Soon
tools.description: List public sales starting in the next few days (default 7, max 14). Good for "what sales are this weekend near X" questions.

tools.name: find_item_for_sale
tools.title: Find Item For Sale
tools.description: Find a specific thing someone wants to buy (furniture, a collectible, a tool) across current public sales, optionally in one city and price range. Returns up to 10 matches with links to cite.

privacy: Read-only public listings. Street addresses, organizer contact details and unpublished or early-access items are never returned.
rateLimits: Per IP: 120 requests per minute overall, 10 to 40 calls per minute per tool.
